currentUserGoal: Build another redesign slice before the user tests later.
summary: Changed the first-run Run Touch gate from 10 RT to 12 RT so 3x3 expansion is slightly delayed without starving the first run.
Added a new `Hold the Line` first-run objective after the first wound triage lesson.
`Hold the Line` keeps the field at 3x3 until the player has healed 3 total wounded roots, then opens the full 5x5 field.
If the run collapses before the player completes `Hold the Line`, dormancy completes the pressure lesson too, avoiding a tutorial soft-lock.
Updated wound-opening Sensi guidance so `Hold the Line` is treated as an early pressure lesson instead of generic background pressure.
Updated redesign docs and implementation plan to describe the new pacing sequence.
